description: List exercises in the catalog, optionally filtered by muscle_group and/or kind.

muscle_group.description: Optional muscle group filter (e.g. legs, chest, back).

kind.description: Optional kind filter: strength | cardio | flexibility.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of {exid, name, muscle_group, kind}.

description: Get a single exercise by exid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the exercise object.

description: Add a new exercise to the catalog.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new exercise.

description: List workouts, optionally filtered by an ISO date range. Sorted by date ascending.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower-bound ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper-bound ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of workout objects.

description: Get the full workout by wkid, including all sets.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the workout object.

description: Create a new workout session with optional initial sets.

sets.description: Optional list of sets: {exid, reps, weight_kg, distance_km, duration_sec}.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the created workout.

description: Update one or more fields on an existing workout. Only supplied fields change.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated workout.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {wkid, deleted: true}.

description: Append a single set (one exercise entry) to an existing workout.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated workout.

description: List personal records, optionally filtered by exercise.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of PR objects sorted by achieved_at desc.

description: Record a new personal record for an exercise.

kind.description: One of max_weight | max_reps | best_time | longest_distance.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new PersonalRecord.

description: List the most recent weekly stats, sorted by week_start_date desc.

limit.description: Maximum number of weeks to return.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of WeeklyStat objects.

description: Compute and persist weekly stats for the 7 days starting at week_start_date.

week_start_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD marking the start of the week.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the computed WeeklyStat.

description: Return a map of muscle_group -> number of sets performed in the given ISO date range.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {muscle_group: count} mapping.

description: Search exercises by keyword across name, muscle_group, and kind.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching exercises.

description: Return aggregate counts across the fitness session (exercises, workouts, PRs, weekly stats, totals by kind).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is an aggregate stats object.

description: Return a per-day map of workouts for a given month.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {month, days: {YYYY-MM-DD: [workout_summary...]}}.
